verdict.rationale: Fenwick operates client-facing technology, including a trademark extranet and AI tools that analyze uploaded briefs and contracts. A buyer could therefore fairly ask whether client data is used for AI training, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no AI-training opt-out, data-use restriction or training-exclusion policy for those tools. The privacy & cybersecurity legal practice is an adjacent legal service, not a product control preventing training on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
